records.source_locator: Section 3.3, printed page 55 / PDF page 10, Latakia spring 2010 paragraph; Figure 12a date support in caption on printed page 56 / PDF page 11.
records.case_label: Latakia spring 2010 cyclonic regional pattern, Figure 12a
records.scope: Near-surface cyclonic circulation pattern in the Latakia recurrent region in spring 2010. Drifter tracks and four-week mean unbiased geostrophic currents.
records.qualification: Dated regional pattern, not a tracked physical eddy or regional constant. The map dates are averaging support, not formation/dissipation or physical lifetime. Spring cyclonic and summer anticyclonic patterns remain separate; not a seasonal envelope or evidence of one eddy changing polarity. No closed contour, uncertainty, annual extrema or interpolated animation inferred. Direct PDF bytes and page images were unavailable; retained primary-text access is qualified.
records.definition: Approximate circulation diameter reported in the case-description paragraph; no fixed contour operator specified.
